note: Reserved purpose — `stepUp` is reserved, not defined in 0.1; the closed Purpose list must reject it.
Reserved mode — `push` is reserved, not defined in 0.1; the closed Mode list must reject it.
Missing mode — both purpose and mode are required.
Unknown member — additionalProperties: false rejects an endpoint smuggled into the request.
A requestId shorter than 22 characters carries fewer than 128 bits and must be rejected.
